4.name: The Whispering Wood
4.overview: After the portal gates separate the Ninja across the Merged Lands without their powers, they frantically search for a safe route back to Ninjago.

4.name: The Lean of a Tree
4.overview: Lloyd begins to grasp his true purpose, while Kai, Nya, and Jay desperately look for a way out when they discover they're trapped in a giant creature.

4.name: Tonight We Hunt Monsters
4.overview: Jay retraces his steps to try and unlock his memories. Frak asks his father and the Explorer's Club for help getting the team home.

4.name: A Wonder of the Merged Lands
4.overview: Sora, Frak, and Wyldfyre race to save Riyu from a deadly poisoning. Meanwhile, an old friend arrives to help Lloyd and the team battle Elemental Monsters.

4.name: Seed and Soil
4.overview: Sora and Frak hunt the Elemental Monster aboard the Explorer's Club ship, while Lloyd faces a crucial ritual at the Temple of the Green Ninja.

4.name: Just Under the Surface
4.overview: Having infiltrated The Administration, Jay, Kai, and Nya attempt a dangerous escape, while Lloyd grapples with the meaning behind his spiritual trial.

4.name: The Grand Inquisition
4.overview: In Umbrasilvis, Sora, Frak, and Wyldfyre form a plan to prove their innocence, while the Whispering Wood rapidly fades the longer Lloyd's ritual goes on.

4.name: Dying to Live
4.overview: Cole overhears crucial details about the Loyalists' deadly plan, and Lloyd comes face-to-face with his greatest enemy in the Temple of the Green Ninja.

4.name: The Heartbeat of All the Realms
4.overview: Imperium comes under attack from the Loyalists and the Elemental Monster army. Meanwhile, Lloyd must find a way to save the Whispering Wood.

4.name: Birthright
4.overview: As Lloyd fights to retrieve the Weapon of Desolation, the Ninja unite and harness a new source of power in the battle to save Imperium.

4.name: Monster in the Monastery
4.overview: When the Weapon of Desolation proves too dangerous to keep in the Monastery, the team must split up to go on a mission to destroy it.

4.name: The Mech Master 10,000
4.overview: A race through Ninjago City with unexpected stakes provides Sora and Arin an opportunity to strengthen their bond.

4.name: In the Pits
4.overview: A detour inspired by Jay's lost memories leads the Ninja to a gladiator pit and a new mission.

4.name: Ancient History
4.overview: While the young Ninja struggle with their public perception, Frak investigates the possible return of a villain.

4.name: A Frozen Scar
4.overview: Crossing into the Never Kingdoms to destroy the Weapon of Desolation, Lloyd's team meets old friends and encounters new dangers.

4.name: 100 Eyes to See Your Soul
4.overview: As delegates arrive for the peace talks, the young Ninja handle a threat behind the scenes with a shocking assist.

4.name: All Wizards Are Liars
4.overview: The young Ninja's chance to figure out the Loyalist plan hinges on Sora, meanwhile the Ninja's new ally is tempted by the Weapon of Desolation.

4.name: The Summit
4.overview: Tensions mount at the peace talks, and the new Ninja must foil a kidnapping plot without derailing negotiations.

4.name: Desperately Seeking Sora
4.overview: The young Ninja scramble to find their captured friend, while at the abyss of Eternal Night, the Ninja's ally faces the ultimate choice.

4.name: Dangerous Connections
4.overview: Loyalists disrupt the Merged Lands Summit, as the Weapon of Desolation resists its own destruction.

overview: A phenomenon known as the Merge has caused many legendary realms to suddenly combine into one, but their union is unstable. A Spinjitzu Ninja Master must train a new generation of heroes to help find Elemental Dragons who can save the planet before the forces of evil use the same dragon energy to destroy this new world.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Wolf-masked warriors. Forbidden fighters. A Blood Moon. Lloyd's dreams may be visions of a startling future — unless the Ninja can rise up and stop it.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The Forbidden Five go on a hunt to obtain the Prismatic Blades in order to awaken a legendary chaos dragon known as Thunderfang. Can the Ninja stop them before it is too late?

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: With the Ninja scattered and their powers weakened, a hidden enemy unleashes Elemental Monsters on the Merged Lands.

tagline: A new generation of heroes are rising!
